scope: Generic Story DEV build UI; fixtures of a new courses application are isolated browser data. No VIDLOC data or application code was reused.

navigation.educationalDetails: How DEV works is collapsed below the actual build action.
navigation.taskOwner: Task view reads the owning Story ID, preserving the consulted attempt and existing navigation.

behaviorReviewed: Fixed integrated commit and contract digest in explicit confirmation; reason and checkbox required.
Queued request, execution, pause, blocker, failure, unknown result, cancellation and successful artifact are separate states.
Artifact confirmation does not claim deployment, tests or Development Finalized.
Known operation/artifact survives a later GET failure; new decisions stay blocked until fresh metadata.
Lost ACK preserves body/persona/idempotency key through tabs and reload; recovery banner remains reachable outside DEV.
Context or persona changes invalidate acceptance while preserving the written reason.
Resume/cancel retain the reviewed operation identity/version; cancellation is exposed only before dispatch.
Focus enters confirmation and explicit result; timer refresh does not direct focus.
Full SHAs and digests wrap; controls remain usable at 390px without document overflow in the primary flow.

initial.note: Same 20 unique cases before compacting the educational content and correcting screenshot position.

existingNavigationFollowUp.scope: Existing DEV/QA navigation at both widths, historical Task destination and keyboard/release-draft preservation.
existingNavigationFollowUp.repair: Visibility of the environment waits for its committed URL. Explicit selection of the current URL replaces pending navigation; focus waits for the URL. Existing test assertions were not changed.

verification.browser: Headless Chromium through the shared regression controller
verification.providers: All API calls in development-build.spec.ts are intercepted; no operational provider/database calls.

resolvedFindings.finding: The old DEV explanation pushed the newly actionable build content down, especially on mobile.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Build first; educational content preserved inside How DEV works details. All 20 cases rerun.

resolvedFindings.finding: FullPage capture at the post-action scroll offset painted fixed header/skip-link in the middle of the exported image.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Focus assertions remain before capture; screenshot helper blurs and scrolls to top before exporting. Eight final images inspected.

limitations: This UX receipt does not attest a real application build, image, deployment, remote executor or production readiness. API/provider/live validation has separate evidence.
No complete screen-reader, native keyboard traversal, browser matrix or WCAG conformance certification. Focus and selected keyboard navigation have scoped assertions.
The Story lifecycle summary is intentionally absent in the intercepted fixture, so its preexisting unconfirmed-summary message is not evidence of a production lifecycle failure.
FullPage captures start at the top and do not certify fixed-header behavior at every scroll/zoom level.
The persistent build query is local current/last-artifact metadata, not a paginated archive of every build. Full history remains in Audit.
No remote CI run is claimed.
